### 🧠 About me

I build AI-powered systems at **ebebek** — taking ideas from a prototype to software that runs reliably in production. Most of my work sits where LLMs meet solid backend engineering: retrieval, agents and tool calling, evaluation, and the infrastructure that keeps it all fast and affordable.

Outside of that I'm constantly shipping: web and mobile apps, internal tools, bots, dashboards and even mobile games. I lean heavily on AI-assisted development to move fast without cutting corners, and I care about systems that are measurable, reliable and grounded in real data.
